cohort: The study included adult women with single pregnancies, aged 20 years and older, who gave birth between January 2020 and August 2024 at a single center.
finding: Adverse perinatal outcomes are more common in pregnant women aged 35 and over, with these outcomes being even more prevalent in the >=40 years age group.
mod_finding: Maternal ages of 35-39 and >=40 years were associated with increased rates of cesarean delivery.
